name: AgriMarket Dev Container
postStartCommand: DOCKER_GID=$$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$$DOCKER_GID" ] && ! getent group "$$DOCKER_GID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo groupadd -g "$$DOCKER_GID" docker-host && sudo usermod -aG "$$DOCKER_GID" vscode; fi; if command -v docker-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker mcp gateway start --port 8811 2>/dev/null || true; fi
